Hamermesh MBA Class of 1961 Professor of Management Practice, Retired MBA Class of 1961 Professor of Management Practice, Retired Richard Hamermesh was the MBA Class of 1961 Professor of Management Practice at the Harvard Business School. While at HBS Richard served as co-chair of the HBS Healthcare Initiative and of the HBS/Kraft Precision Medicine Accelerator . As chair of the Healthcare Initiative, Richard was instrumental in expanding the role of healthcare in MBA education and research.
